quote_zh: 将40g  2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.6％、0.152mol)，200ml二氯乙烷，1g偶氮二异丁腈(99％、0.006mol)，46g氢溴酸(48％、0.273mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在75～80℃滴加20.6g双氧水(30％、0.182mol)，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗、浓缩，异丙醇进行重结晶、过滤、烘干得46.67g白色粉末，纯度99.0％，收率89％。
arithmetic_check: EVERY PAIR CLOSES. Charges, taken with the purity printed alongside each: substrate 40 g at 99.6 percent is 39.84 g, over C10H11ClO4S at 262.71 that is 0.15165 mol against the printed 0.152 mol, correct; azobisisobutyronitrile 1 g at 99 percent is 0.99 g over C8H12N4 at 164.21, 0.00603 against 0.006, correct; hydrobromic acid 46 g at 48 percent is 22.08 g of HBr over 80.91, 0.27289 against 0.273, correct, which also confirms that the 48 percent is a solution strength and the 46 g the mass of solution; hydrogen peroxide 20.6 g at 30 percent is 6.18 g over 34.01, 0.18169 against 0.182, correct on the same reading. No molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure: limiting input 0.152 mol; product methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoate as named and drawn is C10H10BrClO4S, MW 341.60; theoretical 0.152 x 341.60 = 51.92 g; the printed 46.67 g at the stated 99.0 percent purity is 46.20 g of product, which is 88.98 percent of theory against the printed 89 percent. CLOSES to within 0.02 of a percentage point. Note that the closure is on a purity-corrected basis: the gross 46.67 g is 89.88 percent of theory, so the patent is computing its yields on the assayed content, which is consistent across all three steps of this example. No mass_balance_implausible. No scale_discontinuity, this being the first step. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.

quote_zh: 将30g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.0％、0.0869mol)，18g碳酸钾(99％、0.1289mol)，0.9g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.0079mol)，200ml四氢呋喃，10.5g  2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.1039mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在75～80℃进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，滤液浓缩。往剩余物里6g氢氧化钠(99％、0.1485mol)，200ml水，在70～75℃进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得27.6g白色 / 粉末，纯度99.7％，收率91.3％。

Product closure over the whole one-pot step: limiting input 0.0869 mol; product 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid as named and drawn is C11H10ClF3O5S, MW 346.70; theoretical 0.0869 x 346.70 = 30.13 g; the printed 27.6 g at the stated 99.7 percent purity is 27.52 g, which is 91.33 percent of theory against the printed 91.3 percent. Note that the isolation sentence is split by a page break between lines 188 and 193 and the two halves are joined for the quote and for procedure_text.

quote_zh: 将27.4g  2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸(99.7％、0.0788mol)，0.2g  DMF(99％、0.0027mol)，12.3g氯化亚砜(99％、0.102mol)，100ml二氯乙烷加入250ml反应瓶中，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂。将9.5g  1,3-环己二酮(99％、0.084mol)、100ml二氯乙烷加入反应瓶，在25～30℃滴加18.5g三乙胺(99％、0.18mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全。反应完全后，加入1g丙酮氰醇(95％、0.011mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加甲醇进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得30.3g米黄色结晶粉末，纯度98.6％，收率86％。
arithmetic_check: EVERY PAIR CLOSES. Charges, purity-corrected as printed: substrate 27.4 g at 99.7 percent is 27.32 g, over C11H10ClF3O5S at 346.70 that is 0.07879 mol against the printed 0.0788, correct; DMF 0.198 g over 73.09 is 0.00271 against 0.0027, correct; thionyl chloride 12.177 g over SOCl2 at 118.97 is 0.10236 against 0.102, correct; 1,3-cyclohexanedione 9.405 g over C6H8O2 at 112.13 is 0.08388 against 0.084, correct; triethylamine 18.315 g over C6H15N at 101.19 is 0.18099 against the printed 0.18, correct, this being the only charge in the example stated to two decimal places rather than three or four; acetone cyanohydrin 0.95 g over C4H7NO at 85.11 is 0.01116 against 0.011, correct, and it is the only charge in the example stated at 95 percent rather than 99 percent or better. No molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure over the whole one-pot step, against the limiting aromatic acid at 0.0788 mol rather than the dione at 0.084 mol: tembotrione as named and drawn is C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.82; theoretical 0.0788 x 440.82 = 34.74 g; the printed 30.3 g at the stated 98.6 percent purity is 29.88 g, which is 86.01 percent of theory against the printed 86 percent. CLOSES to within 0.01 of a percentage point. No mass_balance_implausible. Continuity: step 2 isolated 27.6 g of this substrate and this step charges 27.4 g, a subset, so scale_discontinuity is NOT raised. SECTION SUMMARY OF THE ARITHMETIC: all three steps close, on both tests. Every one of the fifteen mass, purity and mole triples printed in this example reproduces the stated mole figure to the precision printed, so no molar_mass_inconsistent arises anywhere; and all three product mass, purity and yield sets reproduce the stated yield to within 0.03 of a percentage point when the yield is computed on the purity-corrected product mass against the drawn molecular formula. The purity correction is what makes them close exactly: on the gross masses the three yields would read 89.88, 91.61 and 87.23 percent against the printed 89, 91.3 and 86, so the patent is consistently working on assayed content. The charge chain is also monotonic, 46.67 g isolated then 30 g charged, 27.6 g isolated then 27.4 g charged, so there is no point at which the example consumes more material than it made. This example is internally consistent and no validation flag is raised on any of its three records.
